newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Property Income buys North Sydney building.
newsitem.headline: Property Income buys North Sydney building.

text.p: Macquarie Property Management Ltd, the manager of Property Income Investment Trust (PII), said on Tuesday, the trust had aquired a North Sydney office building from Quickpolar Holdings Ltd for A$37.25 million.
Macquarie said that the property, located at 2 Elizabeth Plaza, North Sydney, had an initial yield of nine percent before acquisition costs.
"The acquisition will increase PII's exposure to the Sydney office market, with 42 percent of assets now located in New South Wales.
The property has 6,914 square metres of office accommodation with 985 square metres of retail and 157 underground car spaces.
Only one percent of the lettable area was currently vacant.

Macquarie said the acquisition would be funded from a placement of 19 million PII units at A$1.00 by Macquarie Underwriting Ltd, a new issue of medium term notes underwritten by Macquarie Bank Ltd, and cash reserves.
